biography: Joni, representing Hill Side Golf Club, holds a truly unique and distinguished place in the history of the Hector Trophée. His involvement is etched into the tournament's twelve-year narrative through a single, yet remarkably impactful, participation.

In that solitary outing, Joni achieved the pinnacle of the pair competition, triumphantly lifting the coveted Hector Trophée. This astonishing feat, accomplished in his only competitive appearance, showcases a player of rare focus and immediate impact. While the individual Victor Trophy remained unclaimed, his contribution to the winning duo solidified his place as a champion.

Following this singular, victorious campaign, Joni has since been regarded as having stepped away from competitive Hector events. Therefore, it comes as no surprise that he will not be among the distinguished field for the upcoming Hector Trophée 2026. His brief yet brilliant chapter serves as a testament to what can be achieved with potent synergy and a fleeting moment of perfection.
